changes: Trigger GitHub Actions explicitly through workflow_dispatch after source verification
Enable the configured workflow automatically when it is disabled
Build the current branch head without creating empty trigger commits
Ignore workflow runs that existed before the new build request
Detect and report when the branch head is newer than the latest workflow run
Keep stale-lock recovery, Runner timeout, and manual unlock behavior
purpose: رفع حالتی که Commitهای جدید روی GitHub ثبت می‌شدند اما Build جدید ساخته نمی‌شد
